name: pedestrian

trans: n. the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions; a safe place

name: traffic accident

name: traffic jam

trans: n. 交通堵塞

name: pollution
trans: n. undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities

name: install
trans: v. set up for use; put into an office or a position

name: erect
trans: v. construct, build, or erect

name: sign
trans: n. a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened); a public display of a message

name: keep clear
trans: 禁止占用

name: out of bounds
trans: n. a line that marks the side boundary of a playing field

name: pavement
trans: n. the paved surface of a thoroughfare; material used to pave an area

name: footpath
trans: n. a trodden path

trans: v. become broader or wider or more extensive; make (clothes) larger

name: colour
trans: v. modify or bias

name: mark
trans: v. attach a tag or label to; designate as if by a mark

name: bend

name: corner

trans: adj. independent; not united or joint; standing apart; not attached to or supported by anything

trans: n. space in which vehicles can be parked; the act of maneuvering a vehicle into a location where it can be left temporarily

trans: n. a lot where cars are parked

trans: adj. incapable of functioning as a consequence of injury or illness

name: pay and display
trans: 泊车付费系统

name: restriction

name: lorry
trans: n. a large low horse-drawn wagon without sides

name: load
trans: v. fill or place a load on; provide (a device) with something necessary

name: obey
trans: v. be obedient to

trans: v. forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper); prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
